_doc: Flavour set-dressing + keep-clear zones per room. Three consumers: (a) maps.html draws light furniture + work-zone hints (Warden), (b) the waypoint router routes the wayfinding line AROUND floor obstacles + work_zones, hugging one side at the design-code clearances, (c) SD image generation uses dressing.desc as flavour and pos/place for the depth pipeline. Floor items have a footprint (obstacle); wall/ceiling items are flavour only. work_zones with equipment:true use the 0.9m NEC clearance, else the 0.35m wall offset. Tone is grimy sci-fi sitcom x deadpan cosmic bureaucracy (Red Dwarf / Douglas Adams / Alien-as-comedy): descs are fun bits + easter-egg stories. Merged into docs/assets/ship.js at regen.

design_code._source: OSHA 1910.36(g) means-of-egress + NEC 110.26 / OSHA 1910.303 working space. Used as a layout/routing GRAMMAR (consistent rules to design + route around), not for realism.

stasis-bay.purpose: Where the crew thaws out (Scene 0). Pods line the port wall; the route leads out toward the commons + ladderway.

work_zones.desc: row of stasis pods venting cold mist; one pod's occupant is just a uniform, a clipboard, and a note reading 'BACK IN 5'

dressing.desc: a tipped IV stand and monitoring cables labelled DO NOT UNPLUG, all unplugged
dented crew lockers; one still holds a dead man's spare Bermuda shorts and a half-finished complaint to the Authority

commons-a.purpose: Wide habitation corridor / commons spanning the deck; the forward-starboard ladderway down to Deck B is off this room.

work_zones.desc: a bolted-down rec table mid-eternal card game; the pot is buttons, IOUs, and one tooth

dressing.desc: vending machines: one sells only 'Bermuda-brand Nutrient Regret', one accepts a currency two regimes dead, one is just GLADYS saying hello
a mop bucket and a WET FLOOR cone guarding a stain the maintenance log has dated to the year 2387

mess-hall.purpose: The mutiny room: galley + commons where the crew congregates and Mr. Munch stages his blockade.

work_zones.desc: galley counter + appliances down the port wall; the toaster has filed three formal grievances
bolted mess tables, sticky with history; the route goes around, because no one survives the middle one

dressing.desc: stacked trays and a tipped condiment caddy; the ketchup has, per the chef, 'developed opinions'
recycling bins sorted into LANDFILL, ALSO LANDFILL, and a third labelled simply HOPE
cork board of aggressively polite memos ('We do hope this finds you well') under a stale 'Employee of the Month: GLADYS' and a chore rota signed entirely 'Not It'
low ducting and a dead fluorescent tube; the duct tape is, structurally, load-bearing

scrubber-corridor.purpose: Narrow service run aft off the mess; the crawlspace dive drops from here. The slime trail starts here.

work_zones.desc: wall of filters and valves; a sticky note reads 'IF GURGLING, IT IS FINE. IF SCREAMING, ALSO FINE.'

dressing.desc: an open toolbox missing the one tool you need, and a coiled hose hand-labelled 'NOT A SNAKE (probably)'
a single caged bulb flickering in what is almost certainly Morse for a swear word

scrubber-control.purpose: Cramped control room for the choking scrubbers; the central crawlspace drops from beside it down toward the hold.

work_zones.desc: pipework, filters and the SCRUBBER FAULT console, every gauge in the red and one taped over with a smiley face

dressing.desc: dripping condensation and a clipboard whose top sheet reads 'SCRUBBER STATUS: fine, honestly, stop asking'

crawlspace.purpose: Hot duct network the party squeezes through (Scene 2). The clogged scrubber intake and the first eggs are here; the duct continues down into the cargo hold.

work_zones.desc: the clogged scrubber intake, packed with something the manual definitely does not cover

dressing.desc: ribbed tunnels, dripping pipes, and a decades-old graffito: 'GLADYS WAS HERE :)'
a pried-up grate and a dropped headlamp still filming; the last frame is just a very surprised eye

cargo-hold.purpose: Vast freezing reclamation hold — the nest. The route runs aft along the deck to the cargo airlock used to vent Brood Mama.

work_zones.desc: webbed cargo containers down the starboard side, stencilled 'FRAGILE', 'THIS WAY UP', and 'DO NOT REANIMATE'
the gaudy gold-trimmed escape pod the nest is draped over; the monogram has been lovingly scratched out

dressing.desc: leaking reclamation drums stencilled 'CONTENTS: BEST NOT', and one suspiciously cosy nest of shredded packing foam
a dead gantry crane, chains swaying, a hard-hat dangling from a hook labelled 'SAFETY (decommissioned)'

cargo-airlock.purpose: The big aft cargo airlock — the way OUT and the kill-box for venting the nest.

work_zones.desc: the cycle-lever console and status ring under a laminated sign: 'IN EVENT OF VACUUM, remain calm and update your timesheet'

dressing.desc: hazard chevrons, frost, a heavy cycle lever, and a scratched tally of everything previously vented (mostly: 'paperwork')
